findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - running the configured repository test suite. This wording change makes both cases of `test_5_coordinator_guide_explains_chat_continuity` fail: `tests/test_worker_and_reader_chats_survive_rounds.py:365` still requires the exact old sentence ending “old chat gone or archived or the item changes tools”. The new sentence no longer contains it, and `src/forge/story.py:89–93` copies this template directly into both generated guides. Update that expectation to the new contract so the suite can pass.
